scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance (SCCS)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise
The enterprise must belong to the manufacturing sector
Production must have started on or after 1st April 2019
The enterprise may be in the private, cooperative, or joint sector undertaking, or a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or the Industrial SHGs
Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) must be between 1st April 2020 and 31st March 2025
benefits_summary: Eligible micro or small enterprises receive reimbursement of 50% of certification expenses, up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000, for specified quality certifications.
